summary: Novanta Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Equity Purchase Agreement on June 8, 2026, to acquire all limited liability company interests of Runway Buyer from Runway Midco for $1.2B cash at closing, plus a $250M milestone payment due by Jan 8, 2027. The acquisition vehicle is Novanta Medical Technologies Corp. Closing conditions include HSR Act clearance, no Material Adverse Effect, and customary reps/ warranties. The deal will be financed through cash and existing credit facilities. Watch for antitrust timeline and integration risk at closing.
